browserSearchPath: CLMS Bio-geophysical Parameters, Vegetation, Dry/Gross Dry Matter Productivity
collectionDescription: Dry Matter Productivity (DMP) represents the overall growth rate or dry biomass increase of the vegetation — that is, the amount of new dry matter produced per unit of time. DMP is closely related to ecosystem Net Primary Production (NPP) but uses units adapted to agro-statistical applications (kg/ha/day). Estimates are generated at 10-day intervals at global scale, with a spatial resolution of about 300 m, and the time series extends from January 2014 to the present.

layers.longDescription: Dry Matter Productivity (DMP) represents the overall growth rate of vegetation — its dry biomass increase — expressed in kg/ha/day.

layers.shortDescription: Quality Flag of the Dry Matter Productivity
layers.longDescription: A per-pixel quality flag (QFLAG) describing the status of the Dry Matter Productivity retrieval, derived from the quality indicator of the input FAPAR product.
